cases.note: a table of first_line calls: the version line doctor keeps

cases.name: status-table
cases.note: the status decision table: one _check_tool call per row

notes: Table cases give `calls` (row name -> arguments) and expect a map of row name -> result.

status-table rows give the catalog tool, how the fake resolver answers (`resolve`: argv, source and kind; null for not found; or `unsupported_shim`), and how the fake runner answers each command line after the resolved argv (`runs`, keyed by the arguments joined with spaces; an `oserror` answer raises OSError with that text). `gates` says whether the project uses gates.
json-rows-* cases pass the given ToolStatus rows and platform to render_json; the expectation is the parsed JSON.
